jobs.title: Senior Director IT Product Management – Marketing & Customer Technology
jobs.description: Overview The Senior Director of IT Product Management serves as a key leader responsible for owning and developing strategic plans for IT products throughout the organization in partnership with SVP, IT Product Management. This position directs and cultivates a team of IT product managers, ensuring technology initiatives are closely aligned with overarching business objectives. The Senior Director is tasked with developing and implementing comprehensive product roadmaps, overseeing the delivery of complex, high-quality portfolios, and leading cross-functional teams to drive business growth, foster innovation, and achieve operational excellence with short to mid-term impact on results. The role reports to our Store Support Office in Phoenix, AZ, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday. Overview of Responsibilities Own and develop a strategic, multi-year product vision for a portfolio of IT offerings that supports organizational goals and addresses customer requirements, while integrating analysis of relevant industry developments. Provide leadership in strategic planning and roadmap development, prioritizing initiatives that deliver business value, enhance operational efficiencies, and address customer needs. Proactively engage with stakeholders to collect insights, manage expectations, and communicate the progress of strategic initiatives. Oversee the IT product portfolio to ensure effective resource & cost allocation, robust risk management, and alignment with organizational priorities. Initiate and collaborate on strategic changes that create lasting impact across IT, business functions, and vendor partnerships, extending beyond individual areas of responsibility. Manage and lead, mentor, and develop a team of IT product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and ongoing improvement. Responsible for making significant improvements in best practices across product management, as well as agile methodologies. Work to influence others through collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and external vendors to ensure comprehensive end-to-end product management—from ideation through development, testing, launch, and post-launch optimization. Proactively assess and anticipate cross-functional team requirements, inform departmental leaders accordingly, and serve as a thought leader within the organization. Demonstrate ownership of complex and diverse portfolios. Determine work prioritization by offering critical insights into value, scope, cost, and resource allocation. Manage both project budgets and Cost Center budgets as required. Ensure team adherence to project management and Scrum processes, working closely with the IT & Enterprise Project Management leadership, providing guidance, and coaching to support proper governance of change management initiatives. Serve as the primary point of contact for all product-related matters, ensuring ongoing stakeholder alignment and a unified understanding of product objectives. Establish a support operating model designed to address escalated calls when On Call team members are unable to resolve issues independently. Define for new solutions and maintain accountability for SOX Controls as required. Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of agile methodologies to foster iterative development and expedite feedback cycles, leading to enhanced product outcomes. Develop and enforce processes and standards that promote efficient and consistent product management practices throughout the organization. Collaborate with the AI Center of Excellence team to conceptualize and deploy AI solutions within their respective portfolios, either through strategic in-house development initiatives or by integrating essential partner technologies into routine operations. Qualifications Knowledge Skills & Abilities Bachelors in business, computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience 15+ years in product management, 7+ in senior leadership roles Experience leading complex IT product portfolios and large-scale strategies Knowledgeable in product frameworks and Agile methods Excellent leadership, mentorship, and team building Strong analytical and decision-making skills Effective communicator with proven stakeholder management Experience with the following Marketing Technology Applications is important: Braze Customer Relationship Management (or similar platforms) NCR LoyaltyPro or other Loyalty and Offer Orchestration solutions CDP & Customer Intelligence Platforms powering personalization (e.g., Databricks) eCommerce & marketplace Platforms (e.g., Instacart StorefrontPro, DoorDash, Uber Eats) Paid media partners and platforms Retail Media Network programs Microsoft PowerBI or similar reporting tools AI platforms/tools driving workplace efficiency (standalone and embedded in above applications) Core Competencies: Communication: Convey information, ideas, and feedback clearly and concisely in an engaging manner that helps others understand and retain the message; listening actively to others. Customer Focus: Place a high priority on the customer’s perspective when making decisions and taking action; implementing service practices that meet the customers’ and own organization’s needs. Driving for Results: Set SMART goals and measure progress; tenaciously working to meet or exceed goals and making continuous improvement. Seeking innovative ways to solve problems that result in unique and differentiated solutions. Positive Approach: Demonstrate a positive attitude in the face of difficult or challenging situations; provide an uplifting (yet realistic) outlook on what the future holds and the opportunities it might present. Coaching and Developing Others: Engaging team members and teams in developing and committing to individual development plans that target specific behaviors, skills, or knowledge needed to ensure performance improvement or prepare for success in new responsibilities; planning and supporting the development of individual skills and abilities. Leading Change: Encouraging others to implement better approaches to address problems and opportunities leading to the implementation and acceptance of change. Strategic Planning: Obtaining information and identifying key issues and relationships relevant to achieve a long-range goal; committing to a course of action to accomplish a long-range goal after developing alternatives based on logical assumptions, facts, available resources, constraints, and organizational values. Benefits In addition to a rewarding career, Sprouts offers a comprehensive program to help support you and your family. These programs include: Competitive pay Sick time plan that you can use to support you or your immediate families health Vacation accrual plan Opportunities for career growth 15% discount for you and one other family member in your household on all purchases made at Sprouts Flexible schedules Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 401(K) Retirement savings plan with a generous company match Company paid life insurance Contests and appreciation events throughout the year full of prizes, food and fun! Eligibility requirements may apply for the following benefits: Bonus based on company and/or individual performance Affordable benefit coverage, including medical, dental and vision Health Savings Account with company match Pre-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for healthcare and dependent care Company paid short-term disability coverage Paid parental leave for both mothers and fathers Paid holidays Get Paid Every Day! Sprouts Farmers Market offers DailyPay - if you’re hired as an eligible employee, you’ll be able to transfer the money you’ve already earned at no extra cost, and get it the next business day, for free. We offer DailyPay so you don’t have to wait for payday to access the money you’ve already worked for. With DailyPay, you can see how much you’ve made every day and you can transfer your money any time before payday. You can learn more by visiting https://www.dailypay.com/partners/sprouts-farmers-market/. Why Sprouts Grow with us! With a focus on customer service, our neighborhood grocery stores offer high-quality, farm fresh produce, natural meats, plenty of scoop-your-own bulk goods and much more in a fun, friendly, old-fashioned farmer’s market setting. Come grow your career in healthy living with a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and teams that pride themselves on empowering others along their journey. jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Owner (Supply Chain Replenishment)
jobs.description: Overview The Senior Technical Product Owner, Supply Chain Replenishment will play a critical role in managing Sprouts’ Supply Chain product domain, with a primary focus on replenishment planning, inventory optimization, demand-driven ordering, and end-to-end product availability. This role is responsible for ensuring technology solutions support efficient inventory flow from suppliers and distribution centers to stores. Acting as the bridge between business operations and technical execution, the Senior Technical Product Owner will work closely with Supply Chain, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Store Operations to develop scalable solutions that improve replenishment accuracy, in-stock performance, inventory productivity, and service levels. The ideal candidate combines deep supply chain replenishment expertise with strong technical product management skills and a strategic mindset. Overview of Responsibilities Leads the configuration and development efforts by conveying the vision, outlining and prioritizing work based on business value Collaborate with stakeholders ensuring their interests are included in the release and the team to ensure the release is developed by the deadline Identify ways to optimize end-to-end technology including processes, adoption of tooling, and opportunities to automate for efficiency gains through owning and providing deep expertise of products Responsible for the product definition and business aspects of the project, including ensuring the right product is being built in the right order Responsible for the 12-month+ product roadmap Work with vendors to prioritize current sprint and future backlogs Support identification of resources with skills to complete upcoming roadmap and sprint work Review and rationalize budget commitments relative to timeline/ scope commitments Understanding of how milestones and deliverables impact budget - accountable to delivery according to plan to avoid budget impact Call out risk/issues to avoid budget impact, help remove issues and create mitigation plans for risks Manage (as necessary) efforts that require traditional waterfall/SDLC project delivery/status (i.e. vendor delivery of an upgrade, enhancements; OCM/communications/training) in adherence with SDLC and PMO standards Manage run-the-business/continuous delivery via a Scrum methodology Ability to gather, document, and determine all types of requirements; define and execute complex solutions; plan, write, and execute testing to ensure solution success, acting as a Test Lead when needed; plan, write, and execute Release Plans as needed Monitor Product Production Queue for new issues, triage, poor system performance; conducts regular audits, assign and/or address according to SLA Support solving escalated calls when On Call team member is unable to resolve themselves Auditing of roles and permissions, as required Research and assess emergent technology in the industry for future strategic growth, bringing forth recommendations to keep Sprouts relevant Coach more junior team members as they grow into product ownership Qualifications Knowledge Skills & Abilities: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience 5-7 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or technical project management, with a focus on technical replenishment products or solutions Strong understanding of retail replenishment processes, inventory management principles, demand forecasting, and supply chain systems Strong understanding of software development and technical concepts, with experience working in Agile environments Proficiency in product management and agile tools Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strategic, customer-focused mindset Core Competencies: Communication: Convey information, ideas, and feedback clearly and concisely in an engaging manner that helps others understand and retain the message;
